about: Installed applications whose names are reserved. Magic code calls these apps; it never copies them or names its own files, declarations or command IDs after them. A name may appear in a native file extension of that app.

imitations.about: Libraries that do an ArtCraft app's job inside our code. Each listed file is a candidate to chain the named CLI instead; reading pixels only to verify a result is QA and may stay.

imitation_hints.about: Agents use magic-cli only. magic-cli commands call the *craft CLIs internally.
imitation_hints.photocraft-cli: magic-cli image.break_apart, image.content_aware_fill, image.color_to_alpha, image.puppet_warp, image.image_size, asset.make_transparent, asset.extract_background, asset.cut_sheet, part.edit_image
imitation_hints.vectorcraft-cli: a new magic-cli command (it calls vectorcraft-cli internally)
imitation_hints.soundcraft-cli: a new magic-cli command (it calls soundcraft-cli internally)

imitation_operations.about: Calls that edit pixels (not just read them). A file importing an imitation library with none of these is QA/reading and is not a task.
